from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0c0b1a5e.py')

source='''from collections import defaultdict, deque
\ndef _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = {(r, c)}
            seen.add((r, c))
            todo = [(r, c)]
            while todo:
                y, x = todo.pop()
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    point = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= point[0] < h and 0 <= point[1] < w
                            and point not in seen and grid[point[0]][point[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(point)
                        cells.add(point)
                        todo.append(point)
            result.append((color, cells))
    return result
\ndef _shape(cells):
    min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    return frozenset((r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells)
\ndef transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    objects = _components(grid)
    colors_by_shape = defaultdict(set)
    for color, cells in objects:
        if color != 1:
            colors_by_shape[_shape(cells)].add(color)
    for color, cells in objects:
        if color == 1:
            matches = colors_by_shape.get(_shape(cells), set())
            if len(matches) == 1:
                replacement = next(iter(matches))
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = replacement
    return out
'''
